summary: Frontend regression for redesigned Intl Shipments combo (Action Center hero + shipments board + Open Orders tab + inline messages). Empty-creds login -> Intl Shipments loads. Hero renders 3 action cards (is-acard-prepay/msg/next), ship-schedule chart, and pipeline rail with 4 KPI rows. All focus/action/table/filter/tab flows behave as specified with 0 page errors and 0 horizontal overflow at 1920/1280/390 widths.

actions.is-act-mark-prepaid: prepay card removed; IS-0011 row now shows Prepaid

verification_details.console_warnings: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits benign width/height(-1) warnings during initial mount / tab-switch renders. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 529 lines and mixes list, hero, detail and modals - Detail (~180 lines) should be extracted to its own module.
useMemo for rows disables react-hooks/exhaustive-deps and misses 'ignored' explicitly - stale closure risk if ignored is later used inside filter beyond unanswered().

Recharts ResponsiveContainer inside .is-hero-chart logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on mount and viewport changes. Consider setting minWidth/minHeight or a fixed height to silence and avoid flicker.
is-attn-ignore-IS-0010 could not be re-verified after is-act-ignore-all (already ignored globally). Suggest separate re-render test or reset control.

Card view testid 'is-kpi-released' actually toggles fStatus 'prepayment' (label 'Focus'/'Focused' on the Collect prepayment card). Consider aligning testid semantics (e.g. is-focus-prepay) to avoid confusion with the rail's is-kpi-prepaid.
seed_data_creation: IS-0013 created transiently through New Shipment flow (client-only state)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review-request flows pass.
